Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, i As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60).Name = "A"
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 250, 80, 60, 40).Name = "B"
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 50, 200, 40, 30).Name = "C"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 0, msoFalse
    Case 1
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 1, msoFalse
    Case 2
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 2, msoFalse
    Case 3
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 3, msoFalse
    Case 4
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 4, msoFalse
    Case 5
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 5, msoFalse
    Case 6
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 0, msoTrue
    Case 7
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 1, msoTrue
    Case 8
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 2, msoTrue
    Case 9
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 3, msoTrue
    Case 10
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 4, msoTrue
    Case 11
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 5, msoTrue
    Case 12
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Align msoAlignCenters, msoFalse
    Case 13
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("B")).Align msoAlignLefts, msoFalse
    Case 14
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("B")).Align msoAlignRights, msoTrue
    Case 15
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align 6, msoFalse
    Case 16
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align msoAlignLefts, 5
    Case 17
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align msoAlignRights, 1
    Case 18
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Align msoAlignRights, -2
    Case 19
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute msoDistributeVertically, 1
    Case 20
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute msoDistributeHorizontally, msoFalse
    Case 21
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute msoDistributeVertically, msoFalse
    Case 22
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute msoDistributeHorizontally, msoTrue
    Case 23
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute msoDistributeVertically, msoTrue
    Case 24
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Distribute msoDistributeHorizontally, msoFalse
    Case 25
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Distribute msoDistributeHorizontally, msoTrue
    Case 26
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("B")).Distribute msoDistributeVertically, msoTrue
    Case 27
        ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute 2, msoFalse
    Case 28
        ws.Shapes("C").Left = 260: ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B", "C")).Distribute msoDistributeHorizontally, msoFalse
    End Select
    For i = 1 To ws.Shapes.Count: s = s & "|" & ws.Shapes(i).Name & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Left & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Top & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Width & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Height: Next
    Tried = "ok" & s
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 28
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
